title: Matangi Rubber IPO Details
intro:
Matangi Rubber IPO is a book build issue of ₹125.16 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 57.62 lakh shares aggregating to ₹99.10 crores and offer for sale of 15.15 lakh shares aggregating to ₹26.06 crores.

Matangi Rubber IPO opens for subscription on Dec 1, 2026 and closes on Dec 3, 2026. The allotment for the Matangi Rubber IPO is expected to be finalized on Dec 4, 2026. Matangi Rubber IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Dec 8, 2026.

Matangi Rubber IPO is set issue price band at ₹163 to ₹172 per share. The lot size for an application is 87 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,964 (87 shares) (based on upper price).

Sarthi Capital Advisors Pvt.ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Matangi Rubber IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated on June 23, 2004 , Matangi Rubber Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of tyres, tyre flaps, tyre tubes and rubber compounds. It primarily caters to the two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyre segments, while its tyre flaps and tubes are used in commercial vehicles such as trucks, buses and heavy utility vehicles. The Company operates through three business models: manufacturing and selling, contract manufacturing and job work services. Under its manufacturing and selling model, it manufactures and sells tyre tubes under its own brand. Its contract manufacturing activities primarily involve producing customised tyre flaps bearing clients’ logos, while its job work services involve processing raw materials supplied by customers into tyres, tyre flaps and tubes in return for conversion charges. The Company also manufactures rubber compounds used in the production of other rubber products.

The Company operates five manufacturing plants across three locations, comprising two facilities at Selaqui, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, two facilities at Bhind, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, and one facility at Gummidipoondi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. These facilities support the manufacturing of tyre flaps, tyre tubes, two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyres and rubber compounds. Its operations are supported by in-house production infrastructure, testing equipment and warehousing facilities for storing raw materials, finished goods and scrap.
The Company has an established manufacturing relationship with JK Tyre and also serves other customers through contract manufacturing and job work arrangements.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 285 employees across its offices and manufacturing locations.

about.text:
Incorporated on June 23, 2004 , Matangi Rubber Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of tyres, tyre flaps, tyre tubes and rubber compounds. It primarily caters to the two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyre segments, while its tyre flaps and tubes are used in commercial vehicles such as trucks, buses and heavy utility vehicles. The Company operates through three business models: manufacturing and selling, contract manufacturing and job work services. Under its manufacturing and selling model, it manufactures and sells tyre tubes under its own brand. Its contract manufacturing activities primarily involve producing customised tyre flaps bearing clients’ logos, while its job work services involve processing raw materials supplied by customers into tyres, tyre flaps and tubes in return for conversion charges. The Company also manufactures rubber compounds used in the production of other rubber products.

The Company operates five manufacturing plants across three locations, comprising two facilities at Selaqui, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, two facilities at Bhind, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, and one facility at Gummidipoondi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. These facilities support the manufacturing of tyre flaps, tyre tubes, two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyres and rubber compounds. Its operations are supported by in-house production infrastructure, testing equipment and warehousing facilities for storing raw materials, finished goods and scrap.

The Company has an established manufacturing relationship with JK Tyre and also serves other customers through contract manufacturing and job work arrangements.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 285 employees across its offices and manufacturing locations.

objectives: 1 — Repayment/ pre-payment in full or in part, of certain outstanding loans availed by the Company
2 — Funding Capital Expenditure requirements for setting up green field manufacturing facility for Rubber Recycling Products (Bhind, Madhya Pradesh)

It primarily caters to the two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyre segments, while its tyre flaps and tubes are used in commercial vehicles such as trucks, buses and heavy utility vehicles. The Company operates through three business models: manufacturing and selling, contract manufacturing and job work services. Under its manufacturing and selling model, it manufactures and sells tyre tubes under its own brand. Its contract manufacturing activities primarily involve producing customised tyre flaps bearing clients’ logos, while its job work services involve processing raw materials supplied by customers into tyres, tyre flaps and tubes in return for conversion charges. The Company also manufactures rubber compounds used in the production of other rubber products.

The Company operates five manufacturing plants across three locations, comprising two facilities at Selaqui, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, two facilities at Bhind, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, and one facility at Gummidipoondi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. These facilities support the manufacturing of tyre flaps, tyre tubes, two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyres and rubber compounds. Its operations are supported by in-house production infrastructure, testing equipment and warehousing facilities for storing raw materials, finished goods and scrap.

The Company has an established manufacturing relationship with JK Tyre and also serves other customers through contract manufacturing and job work arrangements.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 285 employees across its offices and manufacturing locations.

faqs.question: How to apply in Matangi Rubber IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Matangi Rubber IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Matangi Rubber IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Matangi Rubber IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.answer: You can apply in Matangi Rubber IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
